name: indeed-listings
description: Check an Indeed job posting or explain why it is not showing up. Use when an ad needs checking, a vacancy is missing from search, or a posting message needs explaining. For a posting check, supply approved text, country and actual role/location. For missing-job help, start with the message or search observation and country; add relevant status/history/budget evidence. Returns necessary field corrections or an evidence-based next action.
